# Scholastic Teacher

> > Scholastic Teacher provides research-based literacy instruction tools, early learning curricula, and educational resources grounded in the Science of Reading framework.

Scholastic Teacher serves educators with comprehensive reading programs, bilingual early learning solutions, and interactive classroom activities. The platform emphasizes evidence-based literacy instruction through products like Literacy Pro, Scholastic W.O.R.D., and PreK On My Way, supported by foundational research in phonological awareness, phonics, and reading comprehension.

## Key Topics

- Science of Reading
- Literacy instruction
- Reading comprehension
- Phonological awareness
- Phonics programs
- Early learning
- PreK curriculum
- Bilingual education
- Word recognition
- Reading interventions
- Scholastic W.O.R.D.
- Literacy Pro
- PreK On My Way
- Elementary education
- Teacher resources

## Core Literacy Programs

- [Science of Reading | Scholastic Education](https://teacher.scholastic.com/education/science-of-reading/index.html): Scholastic's instructional solutions based on Science of Reading for literacy instruction.
- [Literacy Pro: Empowering Reading Success with Data-Driven Tools & Diverse Ebooks](http://teacher.scholastic.com/products/litpro): Literacy Pro data-driven reading management tool with diverse eBook library.
- [Scholastic W.O.R.D. | Vocabulary and Comprehension Program](http://teacher.scholastic.com/products/WordsOpenReadingDoors/index.html): Award-winning Scholastic W.O.R.D. game-based vocabulary and comprehension program.

## Early Learning & Bilingual Curriculum

- [Scholastic - Prek On My Way](http://teacher.scholastic.com/education/pre-k-on-my-way/NY/index.html): PreK On My Way bilingual early learning curriculum with developmentally appropriate resources.

## Writing & Language Arts

- [Scholastic.com | Teachers: Write It | Essay](http://teacher.scholastic.com/writeit/essay/brainstorm/20issues.htm): Essay writing guide with brainstorming tips and debate topics for students.

## Interactive Learning Activities

- [Listen and Read: Arctic Foxes' Secrets for Survival](http://teacher.scholastic.com/commclub/arcticfox_activity2/page-3.htm): Listen and read activity about arctic fox survival in snowy environments.
- [Max's Math: Max's Fantastical Zoo | Max's Math Adventures Student Activity | Scholastic.com](http://teacher.scholastic.com/max/zoo/index.htm): Max's Math Adventures interactive activity combining shapes and creative drawing.

## Social Studies & History Resources

- [Alexander Miles | African American Inventors | Scholastic.com](http://teacher.scholastic.com/activities/bhistory/inventors/miles.htm): Interactive teaching resource on Alexander Miles and African American inventors.
- [Myths from Around the World](http://teacher.scholastic.com/writewit/mff/norseland.htm): Norse mythology educational resource with Ragnarok and world myth comparisons.

## Educational Products & Materials

- [product-detail-page](http://teacher.scholastic.com/rosa/glos5.htm): Product detail page for Rosa Parks graphic novel with pricing and retailer links.

## Optional

- [Around Alone](http://teacher.scholastic.com/scholasticnews/indepth/sailing/journal.htm): Tim Kent's journal documenting solo sailing race updates and maritime adventure.
